# sleakops Provider

Interact with Sleakops.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configuration-based authentication
provider "sleakops" {
  username = "education"
  password = "test123"
  host     = "http://localhost:19090"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `host` (String) URI for Sleakops API. May also be provided via SLEAKOPS_HOST environment variable.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for Sleakops API. May also be provided via SLEAKOPS_PASSWORD environment variable.
- `username` (String) Username for Sleakops API. May also be provided via SLEAKOPS_USERNAME environment variable.
